products.name: Frase
products.note: SEO content AI; SERP analysis; competitive data scraping; search algorithm dependency

profile_text.body:
Frase is a content platform built around search engine optimization and what it calls generative engine optimization, combining research, writing, optimization, publishing, and monitoring into a single workflow. The company describes itself as a content operating system for AI search, and its site positions the product as a replacement for the multiple separate tools that content teams commonly use. Frase supports native writing in more than 70 languages and offers adjustable autonomy settings that let users choose how much of the publishing and review process the platform handles on its own.

The core Frase product crawls a user's site on arrival, scores each page for SEO and AI readiness, and ranks suggested fixes by impact before drafting any changes. It tracks rankings on Google alongside citations across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Google AI on a daily basis, alerting users when their share of voice shifts. The platform also builds a brand profile from a team's existing published content to make drafted copy match the team's established voice. Pricing starts at $39 per month billed yearly, with the Professional tier at $103 per month, and a 20 percent discount applies to annual billing.

The held facts confirm that Frase is tracked under the Writing and Editing product category, with notes indicating SEO content AI capabilities, SERP analysis, competitive data scraping, and search algorithm dependency as relevant characteristics. The site also references an MCP server and CLI integration that allows Frase to be run from tools such as Claude and Cursor. No litigation or regulatory filings are recorded for the company.
